security_findings.finding: The source Pages pipeline copies raw canonical/admin question data and packaging roots. Existing archive redaction is a denylist and permits content-bearing extra fields. Use a closed public projection; keep the canonical gate and source untouched.

Two synthetic actual-handler counterexamples show high fully hinted practice labeled Mastered and fabricated unaided/challenge claims setting legacy verified=true without authenticated grading. Preserve records; truthful read projections precede grading receipts.
Authenticated server recomputation is not authenticated grading. Client correctness, help, mode, skill and time claims require issued-attempt receipts and versioned certification.
Legacy learning and assessment/drawing/image stores are not all owner-bound; current Studio and queue protections do not cover them.
A safe Pages artifact cannot make public Git source/history private. Source-page media visual scope and licensing also need review.
